Good to know: you will receive a WhatsApp message from us within 15 minutes of submitting your application. We'll ask a few brief questions about your application so we can help you faster. Don't have WhatsApp? No problem! We'll contact you by phone or email instead. 
 what we offer 
 Full-time work in a 5-shift system 
 Travel allowance of €0.25 per km 
 A salary of €17.27 per hour 
 Career opportunities 
 Shift allowance ranging from 34% to 125% 
 You get paid during breaks! 
 who you are 
To keep production running, it is important that you, as a production employee, meet the following requirements: - You are 18 years or older - You have experience working as a production worker - You have your own car or live nearby - You speak Dutch or English - You are available full-time for 5 shifts: (06:30-14:30), (14:30-22:30), (22:30-06:30) - You are physically able to lift bags up to 25 kilos - You have no allergies 
 what will you do 
In the role of production employee at Nutricia in Zoetermeer, you are responsible for filling the mixing plants. This means that you manually lift 25-kilogram bags to the machines daily - so good physical condition is important. Because dust is released during the work, you wear a face mask for your own safety.
